purpose: genuinely unseen confirmation of the locked V5A A50 holiday-closure increment without allowing the cloud research branch to read, tune on, or store 2021-2025 labels or market rows
scientific_question: Does the same-contract SGX A50 price move accumulated while mainland A shares are closed continue to add economically aligned information about the next CSI1000 reopening gap after the retained U.S.-closure and HKMA China-FX channels?

manifest_requirements: source identifiers and local file hashes
SGX archive/key/hash provenance for each A50 holiday event
explicit assertion that no target information at or after 09:25:00 enters A50 features

target.name: CSI1000 next-session opening gap
target.formula: target China 09:31 open / previous China 15:00 close - 1
target.selection_objective: sign and magnitude quality, not trading PnL

feature_semantics.implementation_rule: reproduce the frozen v3/v4/v5 feature code and clocks from candidate_code_sha; do not re-interpret daily dates by convenience
feature_semantics.US: only U.S. observations already closed and observable before the China target open; preserve the frozen complete-clock closure-extra construction
feature_semantics.HKMA_China_FX: preserve the frozen v4 clock correction and target-date prohibition; do not substitute an exact CNH label unless separately preregistered

SGX_A50.contract_selection: nearest non-past CN contract month with an actual trade at or before previous China 15:00
SGX_A50.start: last selected-contract trade at or before previous China 15:00:00
SGX_A50.end: last same-contract trade at or before target China 09:24:59

feature_semantics.forbidden_feature: a50_holiday_preopen_return from V5B is not part of the locked candidate

comparators.selection_comparator: V4_US_HKMA using the exact same unseen rows as V5A
comparators.missing_A50_holiday_event_rule: exclude the event from both V4 and V5A common-sample adjudication; report it separately; never impute or switch contracts

benchmarks: frozen operational baseline IC and sign

conditions: zero A50 ticks at or after 09:25:00
no forward-fill or interpolation that invents market observations
all candidate/comparator metrics computed on an identical common sample
V5A full-unseen IC > V4 full-unseen IC
V5A full-unseen SSE < V4 full-unseen SSE
V5A sign-hit deterioration versus V4 is no worse than 0.01 absolute
V5A holiday-subset SSE < V4 holiday-subset SSE
V5A holiday-subset IC is not lower than V4 holiday-subset IC
V5A holiday-subset sign-hit deterioration versus V4 is no worse than 0.01 absolute
V5A improves full-year SSE versus V4 in at least 3 of the 5 years 2021-2025
V5A has nonnegative annual IC delta versus V4 in at least 3 of the 5 years 2021-2025
gate_3_multi_year_stability.reason: prevent one crisis year or one market regime from defining the confirmation result

conditions: if at least 10 usable unseen holiday events exist, at least 80% of leave-one-event-out cases retain positive holiday-subset SSE improvement versus V4
median leave-one-event-out IC delta is positive
gate_4_fixed_prediction_event_robustness.if_fewer_than_10_events: report the diagnostic but do not treat this gate as passed; final status remains insufficient_event_count_for_baseline_review

decision_rule.all_gates_pass: eligible_for_separate_baseline_replacement_review_only; does not itself authorize baseline replacement, production, registry mutation or holiday runtime routing
decision_rule.other_gate_failure: do_not_promote_V5A; retain current operational baseline and preserve the failure as scientific evidence
decision_rule.mixed_or_insufficient_event_count: retain_as_research_candidate_only and do not tune on 2021-2025 to rescue it

forbidden_selection_inputs: post-hoc holiday-event exclusion except objective data-unavailability under the frozen contract
using 2021-2025 results to revive V5B or tune V5A
